    segs = case['segments']
    n = len(segs)
    budget = case['budget']

    total_min = sum(mins)

    if budget < total_min or budget > total_cap:

    # start with minima

    # track which segments are still active (not at capacity)
    active = [i for i in range(n) if allocs[i] < caps[i]]
    while used < budget and active:
        # find best segment
        best_idx = None
        best_score = -1.0
        best_tie_break = None

            next_pos = allocs[i] + 1
            score = importances[i] / next_pos
            # tie break by original index (lower index wins)
            if best_idx is None or score > best_score or (score == best_score and i < best_tie_break):
                best_idx = i
                best_score = score
                best_tie_break = i
        # give token
        allocs[best_idx] += 1
        used += 1
        # if reached capacity, remove from active
        if allocs[best_idx] == caps[best_idx]:

    # if budget not fully allocated but no active segments, fail (should not happen if budget <= total_cap and budget >= total_min)

    by_name = {names[i]: allocs[i] for i in range(n)}
    return {
        'allocations': allocs,
        'by_name': by_name,
        'total': sum(allocs)
    }"
}
